newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BETIS SACK COACH NINE DAYS BEFORE CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BETIS SACK COACH NINE DAYS BEFORE CUP FINAL.

text.p: Real Betis on Thursday sacked coach Lorenzo Serra Ferrer just nine days before the Spanish Cup final against Barcelona, the club's biggest game for 20 years.
Serra Ferrer, who had clashed with Betis owner Manuel Ruiz de Lopera, is expected to take over the Barcelona reserve teams.
Earlier, Ruiz de Lopera had said Serra Ferrer would be fired unless he signed an agreement not to move to Barcelona.
Betis have also opened disciplinary hearings against Serra Ferrer.
Barcelona chairman Jose Luis Nunez entered the fray by saying Ruiz de Lopera had proposed exchanging the Betis coach for a Barcelona player.
Serra Ferrer joined Betis midway through the 1993-94 season. He took the club out of the second division before clinching a place in Europe in two out of his three seasons in the top flight.
Former player Jose Ramon Esnaola is expected to take over at the club. Esnaola was a hero in Betis's only Spanish Cup win, in 1977 over Athletic Bilbao.
